chief.what_it_is: the tile features the SurvPath rerun in this study consumed, mean-pooled to the case

reading: the comparison on the comparator's own encoder. A full-method value that still clears the published entries means the lead is not an artefact of reading a better slide encoder than the methods it is compared against.
the_other_direction_was_not_run: comparators on TITAN. Not merely expensive: SurvPath and PIBD consume a bag of 4,096 patch tokens while the public TITAN release is one vector per slide, so the substitution is undefined without re-extracting tile-level features from the whole-slide images and retraining both models.
